title: Country Pop
lyrics:
Well I want to thank you
For the drink
But this situation
Isn’t what you think
Yeah, I might be
In this bar alone
But I got me a princess
Back at home
I’m just here
To see my friends
But later
When the evening ends
I won’t stick
Around for long
I’ll say good night
And I’ll be gone

Please don’t take this
Personally
But you won’t get
Nowhere with me

(I’m so good)
I have a girl that’s mine
(I’m so good)
Don’t even waste your time
There really is
No point in trying
Trust me Sweetheart
I ain’t lying
What you’re selling
I ain’t buying
‘Cause I’m so good

I appreciate
Your attention
But there’s something
I should mention
I am not a player
I’m not a flirt
I don’t mess around
I don’t do dirt
No side pieces, no one night stands
I’m strictly a one woman kind of man
This might sound blunt
It might seem curt
But don’t get caught up
‘Cause you might get hurt

Take my advice
Don’t play yourself
You’re better off
With someone else

(I’m so good)
I hope you understand
(I’m so good)
I’m not a single man
There really is
No point in trying
Trust me Sweetheart
I ain’t lying
What you’re selling
I ain’t buying
‘Cause I’m so good

I already
Have a girl
And she’s the best thing
In this world
I’m so happy
That she’s mine
So this is all just
A waste of time

She’s my queen
And I’m her king
And we have an
Exclusive thing

(I’m so good)
I got myself a lover
(So good, so good)
I place no one above her
(I’m so good)
There really is
No point in trying
Trust me Sweetheart
I ain’t lying
What you’re selling
I ain’t buying
‘Cause I’m so good
(I’m so good)

(Oh, I’m so good)
My Baby is the best
(So good, so good)
Don’t even waste your breath
(I’m so good)
It really is
So plain to see
No greater love
Could ever be
There’s nothing
You can do for me
‘Cause I’m so good
(I’m so good)

It really is
So plain to see
No greater love
Could ever be
There’s nothing
You can do for me
‘Cause I’m so good
